# Southern Longview Automotive

> Expert auto service, repair, performance tuning, and restoration in Longview, Texas.

Southern Longview Automotive is a full-service auto repair shop serving Longview, TX and the surrounding East Texas area. We are a small, family-oriented shop and part of a dying breed of full-service facilities that can handle virtually anything between the bumpers — gas and diesel, routine maintenance to full engine replacements, fleet work, and specialty/performance builds.
